name: container
summary: Bounds page or region width with configurable responsive gutters.

agent.useWhen: A page or nested region needs a predictable maximum width and inline edge.
agent.avoidWhen: The parent already owns the required width and gutter.

invariants: Children are already admitted host markup, never a raw HTML instance field.
Width includes responsive inline gutters through border-box sizing; non-full widths center.
The neutral wrapper owns no landmarks, keyboard behavior, JavaScript, routes, or commands.
